content:
Priya (People Ops): Thanks for staying after the all-hands — dropping the hiring/org Q&A here. Post short questions and we’ll answer live. :wave:
Alex (CEO): Appreciate it. High level: we’re approving +18 hires over the next two quarters focused on inference runtime, eng-sre, and dedicated infra. Priorities below.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Can you clarify how that +18 breaks down by team? feels vague in the slides.
Alex (CEO): Sure — rough split: 8 runtime (eng-runtime/eng-ml), 5 eng-sre/infra, 3 product/pm, 2 security/reliability. These are target hires; some may shift to contractors if timing changes.
Maya (Product): Are the 3 PM slots new roles or backfills?
Priya (People Ops): Two are new senior PMs for Optimize & Dedicated features, one is a backfill for Console. We’ll post JD links by EOD.
Ken (Finance): To be explicit: this plan keeps runway stable assuming current ARR growth; any material change in bookings will trigger a hiring pause review.
Leo (SRE): For eng-sre hires — are we hiring for oncall rotation capacity or for platform projects?
Alex (CEO): Both. Priority is oncall capacity for Dedicated SLAs, then platform projects to reduce toil. We expect hired engineers to spend ~40% of time on ops work initially.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Timeline question: when do we start interviewing?
Priya (People Ops): Sourcing starts next week. First onsites planned late next month. Internal referrals welcome — please tag me or use `#hiring-referrals`.
Maya (Product): What about internal mobility? Are teams allowed to pull candidates from other teams?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — we’ll run an internal transfer window. Quick outline:
```
1) Managers indicate candidate interest (2 weeks)
2) People Ops coordinates interviews and approvals (1 week)
3) Final signoff with hiring manager + Finance (3 business days)
```
We’ll publish the calendar tomorrow.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Will we be increasing IC+TL leveling for runtime hires (i.e., more senior profiles) or hiring juniors?
Alex (CEO): Mix — we want senior ICs to unblock architecture work and a few mid-level for throughput. Expect 30–40% senior, rest mid.
Ken (Finance): Salary bands are adjusted up slightly for eng-runtime given market pressure; people ops will share ranges per level.
Ops Bot: @channel Headcount tracker updated: https://internal.redwood/sheets/hc-plan-2170001111 — permissions: everyone read, managers edit.
Priya (People Ops): For interview panels, please include at least one product or SRE reviewer for cross-functional roles. Use the interview rubric linked in the spreadsheet.
Maya (Product): Any reorganizations tied to this hiring? We saw some arrows on the slide but not the full chart.
Alex (CEO): No large-scale reorg today. Small team realignments to create a Runtime Platform group that sits between eng-runtime and eng-platform; org chart update next week. No mass transfers — mostly reporting lines and new TL roles.
Jordan (Eng Manager): TL roles — will they be role changes or promotions?
Priya (People Ops): A mix. We’ll run a promotion cycle for senior ICs who take on TL responsibilities; some hires will join directly as TLs.
Leo (SRE): Oncall load — any plan to compensate for extra rotations while hires ramp?
Ken (Finance): Short term: extra oncall stipend and 0.5 FTE contractor coverage for critical windows. We’ll evaluate after quarter-end.
Alex (CEO): We’ll measure impact on latency/cost KPIs and adjust hiring if needed. Thanks all — please keep Qs coming here. We’ll close this thread after we post the updated org chart and link candidate JDs. :sparkles:
